fields.body: Original L-32 required 18 reading lights. Rev D removes fixtures R16-R18 at the east alcove; revised total is 15. All other lighting remains unchanged.

As the authorized owner PM, I confirm deletion of R16-R18 from the contracted 18-light installation. Rev D is approved and received by your PM. Please prepare a credit proposal for the three omitted fixtures.

Compared original L-32 and Rev D: three east alcove lights deleted. Purchasing confirms R16-R18 were not ordered or installed; remaining 15 fixtures continue. No replacement fixtures or offsetting work requested.
